json.title: JSON Parsing issues in s3 sink Connector
json.body:
Originally, CDC from MySQL is published using [maxwell](http://maxwells-daemon.io/) to an apache Kafka cluster running v2.2.1. 
These events are read using this S3 sink connector v5.2.1 with confluent Kafka 5.2.1 jars. 
**converters in connect-distributed.properties**
`key.converter=org.apache.kafka.connect.json.JsonConverter
value.converter=org.apache.kafka.connect.json.JsonConverter`

**Connector config**
`{
    "connector.class": "io.confluent.connect.s3.S3SinkConnector",
    "behavior.on.null.values": "ignore",
    "s3.region": "ap-southeast-1",
    "flush.size": "10000",
    "schema.compatibility": "NONE",
    "topics": "audit",
    "tasks.max": "4",
    "s3.part.size": "10485760",
    "timezone": "UTC",
    "locale": "en_US_POSIX",
    "retry.backoff.ms": "100",
    "format.class": "io.confluent.connect.s3.format.json.JsonFormat",
    "partitioner.class": "io.confluent.connect.storage.partitioner.HourlyPartitioner",
    "name": "s3-sink-connector-cdc-events",
    "storage.class": "io.confluent.connect.s3.storage.S3Storage",
    "s3.bucket.name": "audit",
    "timestamp.extractor": "Record",
    "s3.retry.backoff.ms": "100",
    "rotate.schedule.interval.ms": "60000"
    }`

This connector works fine mostly. However, I see some parsing errors

So I updated the connector config and added following also:
`   "errors.log.include.messages": "true",
    "errors.deadletterqueue.context.headers.enable": "true",
    "errors.deadletterqueue.topic.name": "audit_dlq_sink_00",
    "errors.tolerance": "all",
    "errors.log.enable": "true",
`

So I had following questions:
1. for a valid JSON, why parsing would fail?
2. In DLQ, only message is going and not the error log or reason why parsing failed.
3. For key, does using a JSON or string converter make any difference? Can I instead use 'key.converter=org.apache.kafka.connect.storage.StringConverter
This error seems more suited for the Apache Kafka JIRA because the error comes from that Converter, and not the S3 Sink
